Definition: Shur, a region of the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Shur = "wall"; 1) a place southwest of Palestine on the eastern border or within the border of Egypt; the Israelites passed through the wilderness of Shur after crossing the Red Sea; 1a) also 'wilderness of Etham'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
